record.title: Arm six-hour isolated lease and explicit link refresh
record.intent: Prepare the operator-requested Ethernet reconnect under fresh capture.
requirements: Preserve prior failed evidence; create a separate run with fresh host baseline.
Change only the single-client lease duration to 21600 seconds. Retain no gateway, DNS, forwarding, sharing, NAT or bridge.
Retain frozen read-only identity and eleven option queries; gate them on operator reconnect confirmation and captured valid ACK.
Verify offline lease shape and duration, supervisor syntax, and current isolation. Commit and push preparation before arming.
Start full capture and responder before telling the operator to reconnect Ethernet. Record the explicit transition on confirmation; do not request other cable or control changes.
acceptance: Capture and six-hour single-client responder are healthy before the operator transition.
